items.q: What should you remember about **One agent, six workflow tools**?
items.a: **orchestrator stays thin; complexity** lives in specialized sub-workflows linked via "Call n8n workflow" nodes.

items.q: What should you remember about **Telegram as UI**?
items.a: **voice transcribed to text; both** paths normalize to JSON.text so the agent sees one input shape.

items.q: What should you remember about **Simple system prompt wins**?
items.a: **list each tool and when to use** it; handle synonyms ("make" = edit); avoid duplicate delivery for blog/LinkedIn (sub-workflow sends content).

items.q: What should you remember about **Google Sheets as image database**?
items.a: **columns**: title, type, request, ID (Drive file ID), link, post; search workflow retrieves by title for edits or recall.

items.q: What should you remember about **Structured outputs everywhere**?
items.a: **image search agent returns name/ID/link/status;** blog flow outputs title + prompt for downstream image gen.

items.q: What should you remember about **Edit vs create images**?
items.a: **OpenAI edit endpoint requires the prior** image binary; search workflow passes back Drive ID before edit workflow downloads it.

items.q: What should you remember about **HTTP gotcha**?
items.a: **replace double quotes in** image prompts before HTTP requests or generation fails.

items.q: What should you remember about **Video pipeline**?
items.a: **4-part story → split out → Flux images →** wait/poll → Runway 5-sec clips → ElevenLabs 5-sec SFX → Creatomate stitch; prefer polling over fixed 90s waits.

items.q: What should you remember about **Cost ballpark**?
items.a: **n8n cloud ~$27/mo; ~$0.19/image (OpenAI); Flux ~$0.015/image; Runway** ~$0.25/5-sec clip (~$1/video); Creatomate ~1 credit/render; ElevenLabs starter $5/mo; GPT-4.1 mini for reasoning via Open Router.
**import 7 JSON workflows, link tool references by** name, copy Google Sheet template, paste Creatomate API curl, plug API keys (OpenAI, Open Router, Google, Telegram).
